g.text: AI exposure, employment and unemployment in Korea
6 Skilled agriculture · 7 Craft · 8 Plant and machine operators · 9 Elementary occupations
Both panels use May EAPS observations for 2022 and 2025, ages 15+. Lines are descriptive WLS fits weighted by May 2022 employment.
Linked unemployment = unemployed persons with a valid previous occupation / (currently employed + linked unemployed).
First-time and other unlinked jobseekers are excluded. This is not the official overall unemployment rate or an estimate of an AI effect.
